color_trap.conclusion: PASSED: Model correctly relies on weave structure/motifs rather than superficial color matching. Rejection of same-color distractor motifs is robust.

dataset_inspection.colorway_structure: Each design_dir contains 8 colorways (palette_00 to palette_07)
dataset_inspection.color_invariance_note: The dataset IS structured for color-invariant evaluation: each design_id appears in 8 different color palettes. Cross-palette retrieval tests whether the model matches the same design regardless of color.

data_leakage.summary: Zero data leakage confirmed: Train, Validation, and Test sets have mutually exclusive design IDs. No identical or near-duplicate images span across splits. Gallery and Query sets use strictly disjoint colorways (gallery: palette_00..03, query: palette_04..07) of test designs.
